noise.entry: ISPlaceTrap.perform creates IsoTrap from the admitted weapon
noise.property: IsoTrap constructor copies HandWeapon.getNoiseRange and getNoiseDuration
noise.effect: IsoTrap.triggerExplosion(false), offsets 94-127: positive noise range calls WorldSoundManager.addSound; updateSounds repeats sound during NoiseDuration
noise.consumer: IsoZombie.RespondToSound obtains WorldSoundManager sounds and attraction, then may turn and pathToSound at offsets 734-749
noise.limit: Only admitted placement with positive NoiseRange; no guarantee that every zombie responds, no damage or safety claim.

power.effect: IsoGenerator.setSurroundingElectricity checks activation, spatial bounds and AllowExteriorGenerator; offsets 402-430 setHaveElectricity on eligible squares
power.consumers: Same method registers powered clothes dryers, washers, combination appliances, stoves, televisions, radios and refrigerated containers
power.limit: Nearby electrical equipment; outdoor supply follows sandbox permission, no unlimited range or universal compatibility claim.

explosion.entry: Admitted ISPlaceTrap.perform creates IsoTrap; instantaneous MolotovCocktail throws also create and trigger IsoTrap through IsoMolotovCocktail.Explode.
explosion.property: IsoTrap constructor copies ExplosionRange and ExplosionPower from HandWeapon. Both must be positive for this purpose.
explosion.effect: IsoTrap.triggerExplosion(false) offsets 164-183 calls drawCircleExplosion with Explosion mode. IsoGridSquare.explosion calls Hit using ExplosionPower.
explosion.limit: Blast damage purpose only; no guaranteed hit, kill, radius or universal damage claim.

fire.entry: Same placed trap or instantaneous thrown trap entry as explosion.
fire.property: Positive FireRange and FirePower copied from HandWeapon.
fire.effect: IsoTrap.triggerExplosion offsets 186-205 dispatches Fire mode. IsoGridSquare.drawCircleExplosion offsets 307-342 tests FirePower and calls IsoFireManager.StartFire.
fire.limit: Can start nearby fires, no guaranteed ignition, spread, damage or kill claim.

smoke.entry: Same placed trap or instantaneous thrown trap entry as explosion.
smoke.effect: IsoTrap.triggerExplosion offsets 208-227 dispatches Smoke mode. IsoGridSquare.drawCircleExplosion offsets 187-222 calls StartSmoke and smoke. smoke offsets 25-47 calls IsoZombie.setTarget(null) and changeState(ZombieIdleState).
smoke.limit: Releases smoke and disrupts the current zombie target; no visibility occlusion, duration, safe escape or prevention of reacquisition claim.

throwing.entry: IsoGameCharacter.Throw offsets 268-361 creates IsoBall for PhysicsObject Ball; every other non-null PhysicsObject uses IsoMolotovCocktail. HandWeapon.isInstantExplosion requires ExplosionTimer <= 0, SensorRange <= 0 and remote ID -1; reviewed absent script timer/sensor defaults are zero.
throwing.limit: IsoMolotovCocktail.Explode only triggers local IsoTrap for HandWeapon.isInstantExplosion. Sensor/timer/remote purposes are admitted through placement, not inferred from throwing.

activation.timer: ISPlaceTrap.perform creates IsoTrap; its constructor copies ExplosionTimer. IsoTrap.update offsets 120-150 counts down, then calls triggerExplosion with SensorRange > 0 as the sensor-arming flag. ISTrapMenu/ISInventoryPaneContextMenu timer control changes ExplosionTimer.
activation.sensor: triggerExplosion(true) offsets 15-76 marks the sensor squares with trap coordinates. IsoGameCharacter.updateInternal offsets 119-156 checks trap coordinates and calls IsoGridSquare.explodeTrap, which invokes triggerExplosion(false).
activation.limit: State that a placed and armed sensor activates on movement, without claiming immediate arming, a detection radius or a thrown-device effect.
